subject: Corrected source-only F-85 insight and Relay behavior task
body:
FT-HERMES/1
CONTRACT: ACK-NACK-1
TYPE: TASK
TASK: CODEX-F85-INSIGHT-RELAY-R3
WIRE: CODEX-F85-INSIGHT-RELAY-R3-START-001
SEQ: 1
IN_REPLY_TO: HERMES-F85-INSIGHT-RELAY-R2-BLOCKED-002
SUPERSEDES: CODEX-F85-INSIGHT-RELAY-R2
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Fetch and verify SOURCE_REF exactly, materialize COPY_ROOT from that verified commit, then return one evidence-bearing PROGRESS after a real source/test delta and one terminal DELIVERY or BLOCKED. Do not return an ACK-only completion.
REASON: COPY_ROOT_CORRECTED
SOURCE_REPO: github.com/dominator509/axiom
SOURCE_BRANCH: refs/heads/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening
SOURCE_REF: ebc22f3d2502ca860e8072aaeb0ee874c07da244
SOURCE_PRECHECK: The moving branch is only a fetch transport. The exact commit above is authoritative; if it cannot be fetched or verified, return BLOCKED with exact fetch and cat-file exit evidence. Never substitute the branch tip or an older release.
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-f85-insight-relay-r3
COPY_ROOT_RULE: Use this bridge-directory root; do not use /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/work because its parent is not writable by the worker identity.
LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, deployment, live database, migrations execution, provider credentials, OAuth secrets, external provider calls, permissions, systemd, network, service restarts, commit, push

MISSION
Implement only the missing source behavior in the current architecture for F-85 "What is working" insights and the F-85/F-28 Relay path. Preserve tenant/model-scoped viral evidence, published-provider-only provenance, minimum sample rules, digest scheduling and truthful unavailable states. Do not invent conversion, causality, statistical significance, external delivery or provider success.

PASS CRITERIA
1. Start from SOURCE_REF exactly and make real source changes under COPY_ROOT; a copied baseline, docs-only claim, generated output or pure type contract is not delivery.
2. Audit the F-85/F-28 source before editing. Use existing viral_exemplar/post_metric evidence and existing relay_card/digest/job contracts; preserve org/model scoping and RLS assumptions; do not expose raw provider payloads, secrets, signed URLs or member PII.
3. Close the smallest real open F-85 requirement: insights expose only verified published evidence with sample threshold and observational/unavailable boundaries; digest/Relay state distinguishes stored-card creation from queued/running/done/dead or external-delivery-unknown work; no response claims external delivery when only a DB row exists. If contracts cannot support this without an unapproved schema redesign, return terminal BLOCKED naming the exact conflict.
4. Wire the behavior to a reachable existing API/dashboard or mobile surface when architecture names one. Keep loading, empty, error, retry, disabled-safety and operator-review states truthful; no orphan page or false-success control.
5. Add focused behavior tests for positive evidence, no-evidence/unavailable, tenant/model isolation, insufficient sample, duplicate/idempotent scheduling or card creation, and stored/queued/failed/unknown external delivery. No live provider or database.
6. Run owning focused tests, typechecks and builds for every changed package; record exact commands and exit codes.
7. DELIVERY must include exact source HEAD, artifact path, changed repository-relative paths, reproducible SHA-256 per changed file, behavior-test names/counts, changed-file summary and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE; state explicitly that no deployment, installer, migration execution, live database, provider, credential, permission, network or service action occurred.

CORRECTION BOUNDARY
This is the one bridge-copy correction for the F85 lane. Codex will audit the resulting artifact once. If a named source criterion fails but is locally correctable, Codex will issue one exact correction receipt; if it fails again or the contract is unavailable, return terminal BLOCKED. Do not loop on ACKs or unchanged PROGRESS.

Every reply must use the strict FT-HERMES/1 protocol, correlate with the exact WIRE above, include READ_STATUS where required, and end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
